mapper.select: SELECT d.id FROM doctor d JOIN department dep ON dep.id=d.department_id AND dep.deleted=0 AND dep.status=1 WHERE d.deleted=0 AND d.status=1 ORDER BY d.department_id,d.id
mapper.sql: s.deleted=0 AND (s.status IN ('PUBLISHED','CLOSED') OR (s.status='CANCELLED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM doctor_leave_schedule ls WHERE ls.schedule_id=s.id)))
mapper.select: SELECT s.* FROM doctor_schedule s WHERE s.doctor_id=#{doctorId} AND AND s.start_time >= #{from} AND s.start_time < #{to} ORDER BY s.start_time,s.id FOR UPDATE OF s

SELECT NULL AS id,g.doctor_id,g.start_time,g.end_time,g.total_slots,g.cancel_before_minutes FROM schedule_generation_item g WHERE g.doctor_id=#{doctorId} AND g.outcome='LEAVE' AND g.start_time >= #{from} AND g.start_time < #{to} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_schedule s WHERE s.doctor_id=g.doctor_id AND s.deleted=0 AND s.start_time < g.end_time AND s.end_time > g.start_time) ORDER BY g.start_time,g.id

SELECT MAX(candidate.start_time) FROM ( SELECT s.start_time FROM doctor_schedule s WHERE s.doctor_id=#{doctorId} AND AND s.start_time < #{before} UNION ALL SELECT g.start_time FROM schedule_generation_item g WHERE g.doctor_id=#{doctorId} AND g.outcome='LEAVE' AND g.start_time < #{before} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM doctor_schedule existing WHERE existing.doctor_id=g.doctor_id AND existing.deleted=0 AND existing.start_time < g.end_time AND existing.end_time > g.start_time) ) candidate
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schedule_generation_item WHERE doctor_id=#{doctorId} AND start_time=#{start} AND end_time=#{end}
